policies.B1: A travel broker gains preferred agency status when executing at least 400 corporate charters yearly or retaining an active IATA Accreditation.
policies.B2: An agency receives corporate flight clearance if it maintains preferred agency rank and commands a jet fleet of at least 10 aircraft.
policies.D1: A carrier receives an international summit logistics agreement when granted corporate flight clearance.
policies.B3: A passenger vessel operator obtains premier fleet status provided its customer satisfaction rating is 85 percent or higher.
policies.B4: A freight entity qualifies for priority customs entry upon holding valid CTPAT certification.

decoy_policies: A rail operator receives high-speed transit certification when operating at least 20 electric locomotives.
A hotel partner qualifies for luxury network inclusion if it maintains a regional hospitality review score of 4.8 or higher.
